author: Ali550n
quote:
All Rockstar does is bloat the game with useless details to sell increasingly expensive hardware; meanwhile, they don’t change their mission design, the gunplay is the same as in GTA: San Andreas, and there’s no decent cover system.
A score of zero might not reflect the game’s true quality, but since many media outlets were bought off and gave it a perfect score, I feel obligated to help balance things out.
